answer: Reputation is valuable only if it cannot be shuffled between aliases, so freeze it behind a time lock: after any transfer, the receiving identity weighted vote and seat eligibility drop to zero for 20 epochs, verified by the ledger. A nadir ring of fast rotations earns nothing but cooldown, and the more hops an operator runs, the longer its chain sits cold. Each inlet of freshly shuffled weight is quarantined, and like quartz that must settle before it can refract, an identity pays the full cooldown to borrow weight it cannot hold.
